context: Evaluate shared memory tile layout strategies for reading column 0 from a 32x32 float tile stored in shared memory. Thread t reads row t. Each float element is 4 bytes. Byte offset for thread t is computed from the row stride and any address transform.

no_padding.description: Standard row-major layout. Each row occupies 32 float elements contiguously. Stride between consecutive rows is 32 elements.

pad_1.description: Row-major layout with 1 padding element appended after each row. Stride between consecutive rows is 33 elements.

pad_2.description: Row-major layout with 2 padding elements appended after each row. Stride between consecutive rows is 34 elements.

xor_swizzle.description: Row-major layout with 32-element stride but XOR-based index remapping. When accessing element [row][col], the physical column index is computed as (col XOR row). This remaps the storage location without changing the logical layout.
